document.text:
A modular order-processing service separates the API component, order component, payment component, and database. The API component calls the order component through its published interface. The order component requires the payment component to authorize a purchase, and both components require the database to store durable state.

Dependency direction is constrained: the payment component must not call the API component. This separation prevents transport details from becoming part of payment logic. Published interfaces enable components to change internally without forcing callers to change, while direct access to another component's private data increases coupling.

The database is shared infrastructure, so a schema change can still affect both order and payment components. Keeping database access behind component interfaces decreases that coupling but adds implementation work and may make cross-component queries slower.

entities.description: A service organized into separate API, order, payment, and database components.

entities.name: order component
entities.description: A component responsible for order-related processing.

entities.name: payment component
entities.description: A component responsible for payment-related processing and purchase authorization.

entities.name: database
entities.description: Shared infrastructure used to store durable state for the order and payment components.

entities.name: published interface
entities.description: An externally available component interface used by callers to interact with a component.

entities.name: purchase authorization
entities.description: Authorization of a purchase required by the order component.

entities.name: durable state storage
entities.description: Storage of persistent state in the database.

entities.name: dependency direction constraint
entities.description: A restriction governing which component may call another component.

entities.name: payment logic
entities.description: Internal logic of the payment component.

entities.name: private component data
entities.description: Data kept internal to a component rather than exposed through its interface.

entities.name: coupling
entities.description: The degree of interdependence between components.

entities.name: database schema change
entities.description: A change to the shared database schema.

entities.name: implementation work
entities.description: Additional work required to keep database access behind component interfaces.

entities.name: cross-component query performance
entities.description: The speed of queries spanning component boundaries.
